title: packages: the publish-drafts door accepts a non-string `message` and publishes with the default note instead of refusing it 400
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Filing gate: ② a finding a dev report carried out of scope (#28406 item 4's dev, draft PR #28447, out-of-scope finding 1, os-dev-report 6546543076). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Reader: `domain:server`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` (the `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` door, ≈L1890–1915); next PR after #28414 lands, since #28414 is editing the same file now.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "publish-drafts message validation" → 9 hits, none about the request body's `message` (closest: #7023 capability floor, #24253 backfill, both closed).
reach: public HTTP entry, measured by #28447's conformance suite: `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/publish-drafts` with `{"message": 42}` answers 200 and publishes with the default "publish app package …" note.

**What is wrong.** #28447 declares the door's body as `PublishPackageDraftsRequestSchema` (`message?: string`, `backfill?: { object, field }[]`, unknown keys stripped). The door does not parse its body with it: it forwards `message` only when it is a string and silently drops anything else, so a caller that sends a number, an object or an array gets a 200 and a history row with the default note, never learning its note was ignored. `backfill` is already judged by the protocol (400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`), so only `message` diverges.

**Wanted.** The door parses its body with `PublishPackageDraftsRequestSchema` and refuses a body the schema refuses with 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `message`. Unknown keys stay stripped (the SDK still sends its deprecated `opts.actor`). Flip the known-divergence pin in `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-publish-drafts-request-conformance.test.ts` (added by #28447) and the matching sentence of the route-ledger row note.

**Not here.** The body `actor` reads on the six sibling package doors and the app re-save (#28414).

Links back: #28406, PR #28447, #28414, ADR-0146 D1.

Blocked-by: #28447
